known_item_source: DataCite arXiv DOI metadata; English titles and abstracts, no added keywords
csfcube_protocol: Each facet query uses the title and author-released automatically labeled sentences (full abstract fallback). Sorted judged pool IDs; no self augmentation. Exponential gain nDCG; relevance grade >=2 for Hit and Recall.

paired_intervals.method: 2,000 deterministic paired bootstrap replicates; known items clustered by original intent, CSFCube facets by original query paper ID. Deliberately selected known items do not represent a random sample of CS questions.

litsearch.query_provenance: The official LitSearch collection combines author-written questions and expert-reviewed questions constructed using citation contexts. The hash sample mixes origins.
litsearch.protocol: Fixed diagnostic subset, not official full-corpus scores. Common pool includes every gold paper in the original 597 questions with both title and abstract. Every other paper is a competitor. Use the 100 lowest SHA256 based on CLinkRAG-litsearch-v1: + query ID among queries with all targets present.
